comment: SSOT for the review-finding severity model this repository gates on. `gating` lists the severities whose unresolved review threads red the `Review findings resolved` merge gate; `icons` maps every severity to the emoji its posted finding leads with (the gate's fallback signal for threads posted before the hidden marker existed). Consumers: review-findings-gate.sh (builds its thread predicate from this file at runtime), .github/prompts/claude-pr-review.md (tells the reviewer which severities hold the merge). The reviewer itself renders findings from agent-review's own copy of this file; this one decides only what gates here.
